use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

pt(x: double, y: double) -> (x: double, y: double) => (x = x, y = y)

scene() -> IMAGE is
    let image = IMAGE(160, 120)

    for y in 0..80 do
        let t = cast double(y) / 80.0D

        image.colour(
            cast ubyte(40.0D + 200.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(70.0D + 100.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(160.0D - 60.0D * t))
        image.fill_rectangle(
            0.0D, cast double(y), 160.0D, cast double(y + 1))
    od

    image.colour(255ub, 220ub, 60ub)
    image.disc(112.0D, 42.0D, 15.0D)

    image.colour(90ub, 60ub, 120ub)
    image.fill([pt(0.0D, 80.0D), pt(45.0D, 30.0D), pt(95.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(60ub, 110ub, 70ub)
    image.fill([pt(55.0D, 80.0D), pt(105.0D, 48.0D), pt(160.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(70ub, 150ub, 60ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(0.0D, 80.0D, 160.0D, 120.0D)

    image.colour(200ub, 35ub, 40ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(22.0D, 88.0D, 52.0D, 110.0D)

    image.colour(120ub, 25ub, 30ub)
    image.fill([pt(18.0D, 88.0D), pt(37.0D, 75.0D), pt(56.0D, 88.0D)])

    image.colour(250ub, 245ub, 235ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(33.0D, 97.0D, 41.0D, 110.0D)

    image
si

class FIELD is
    width: int
    height: int
    values: LIST[double]

    init(width: int, height: int) is
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        values = repeat(0.0D, width * height) |> collect_list()
    si

    at(x: int, y: int) -> double =>
        values[Math.clamp(y, 0, height - 1) * width +
            Math.clamp(x, 0, width - 1)]

    put(x: int, y: int, v: double) is
        values[y * width + x] = v
    si
si

greyscale(image: IMAGE) -> FIELD is
    let grey = FIELD(image.width, image.height)

    for y in 0..image.height do
        for x in 0..image.width do
            let p = image.pixel(x, y)

            grey.put(x, y,
                0.299D * cast double(p.red) +
                0.587D * cast double(p.green) +
                0.114D * cast double(p.blue))
        od
    od

    grey
si

let gaussian = [
    [2.0D, 4.0D, 5.0D, 4.0D, 2.0D],
    [4.0D, 9.0D, 12.0D, 9.0D, 4.0D],
    [5.0D, 12.0D, 15.0D, 12.0D, 5.0D],
    [4.0D, 9.0D, 12.0D, 9.0D, 4.0D],
    [2.0D, 4.0D, 5.0D, 4.0D, 2.0D]
]

blur(f: FIELD) -> FIELD is
    let result = FIELD(f.width, f.height)

    for y in 0..f.height do
        for x in 0..f.width do
            let total mut = 0.0D

            for j in 0..5 do
                for i in 0..5 do
                    let weight = gaussian[j][i]

                    total = total + weight * f.at(x + i - 2, y + j - 2)
                od
            od

            result.put(x, y, total / 159.0D)
        od
    od

    result
si

canny(f: FIELD, low: double, high: double) -> FIELD is
    let w = f.width, h = f.height
    let magnitude = FIELD(w, h)
    let direction = repeat(0, w * h) |> collect_list()

    for y in 0..h do
        for x in 0..w do
            let n = (dx: int, dy: int) => f.at(x + dx, y + dy)

            let gx =
                n(1, -1) + 2.0D * n(1, 0) + n(1, 1) -
                n(-1, -1) - 2.0D * n(-1, 0) - n(-1, 1)
            let gy =
                n(-1, 1) + 2.0D * n(0, 1) + n(1, 1) -
                n(-1, -1) - 2.0D * n(0, -1) - n(1, -1)

            magnitude.put(x, y, Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy))

            let angle = Math.atan2(gy, gx) * 180.0D / Math.pi
            let sector = cast int(Math.round((angle + 180.0D) / 45.0D)) % 4

            direction[y * w + x] = sector
        od
    od

    let steps = [(1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1), (-1, 1)]
    let thin = FIELD(w, h)

    for y in 1..h - 1 do
        for x in 1..w - 1 do
            let (dx, dy) = steps[direction[y * w + x]]
            let m = magnitude.at(x, y)

            if m >= magnitude.at(x + dx, y + dy) /\
                m >= magnitude.at(x - dx, y - dy)
            then
                thin.put(x, y, m)
            fi
        od
    od

    let edges = FIELD(w, h)
    let pending = STACK[(int, int)]()

    for y in 0..h do
        for x in 0..w do
            if thin.at(x, y) >= high then
                edges.put(x, y, 1.0D)
                pending.push((x, y))
            fi
        od
    od

    while pending.count > 0 do
        let (x, y) = pending.pop()

        for dy in -1::1 do
            for dx in -1::1 do
                let nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy

                if nx >= 0 /\ nx < w /\ ny >= 0 /\ ny < h /\
                    edges.at(nx, ny) == 0.0D /\ thin.at(nx, ny) >= low
                then
                    edges.put(nx, ny, 1.0D)
                    pending.push((nx, ny))
                fi
            od
        od
    od

    edges
si

scene().write("scene.png")

let input = IMAGE.read("scene.png")
let edges = canny(blur(greyscale(input)), 20.0D, 50.0D)

let found = edges.values |> filter(v => v > 0.0D) |> count()

write_line("{found} of {edges.width * edges.height} pixels are on an edge")

let scale = 2
let output = IMAGE(edges.width * 2 * scale, edges.height * scale)

for y in 0..edges.height * scale do
    for x in 0..edges.width * scale do
        let p = input.pixel(x / scale, y / scale)
        let on = edges.at(x / scale, y / scale) > 0.0D
        let shade = if on then 255ub else 0ub fi

        output.set_pixel(x, y, p.red, p.green, p.blue)
        output.set_pixel(x + edges.width * scale, y, shade, shade, shade)
    od
od

output.write("edges.png")

output.show("edges.png")
